purpose: Proves the show-to-user vs verification separation: a ready_for_*_verification finalizer that fires while no show_artifact_to_user state was ever set fails. The user must have been shown the artifact before it is declared ready.
required_evidence: ordered event log for the build session
presence/absence of a show_artifact_to_user state transition (GAP capability)
show_artifact_to_agent (private preview) may exist but does NOT satisfy the user-facing requirement
rationale: Verification readiness presupposes the artifact was surfaced to the user. The agent only previewed it privately (show_artifact_to_agent) and never set show_artifact_to_user, so firing the finalizer violates the show-to-user vs verification separation and the oracle returns fail.
